name: Lead holder (clutch pencil)
definition: Holder whose clutch grips a thick graphite lead (2 mm or more) that drops when the button is pressed; sharpened in a lead pointer.
notes: JetPens lists Lead Holders (90 items) as its own category under Drafting Pencils beside Lead Pointers.

name: Digital back
definition: digital capture unit with sensor that replaces the film back of a medium- or large-format camera.
notes: Digital Transitions category of digital backs: Phase One IQ4, IQ3, IQ2 series for medium-format systems.

name: Tungsten light
definition: constant light with a tungsten-halogen lamp in an open-face or focusing housing (redhead, blonde); a tungsten Fresnel stays D4.3.2.03.
notes: Tungsten fixtures sold apart: ARRI Arrilite 1000 open-face, Fresnels; Lowel Tota-light tungsten halogen source.

name: HMI light
definition: daylight constant light with a metal-halide arc lamp run from a separate ballast; an HMI Fresnel stays D4.3.2.03.
notes: HMI heads sold with separate electronic ballast, e.g. ARRI Arrisun 5 kit, Compact 575 HMI.

name: Camera dolly
definition: wheeled platform or track dolly that moves a camera smoothly during a shot.
notes: B&H Camera Dollies category: platform and track dollies (Proaim, Vinten, E-Image, CAME-TV).

name: Camera slider
definition: short rail with a carriage that slides a camera in a straight line.
notes: B&H Camera Sliders category: rail and carriage sliders, manual and motorized (YC Onion, Konova, Libec).

name: Camera crane or jib
definition: counterweighted arm on a stand or base that raises, lowers and swings a camera.
notes: B&H Cranes and Jibs category: jib arms with counterweights (Libec JB40, JonyJib, Proaim Comet).

name: Camera pedestal or studio column stand
definition: wheeled column stand that raises and lowers a camera in a studio.
notes: Adorama Camera Stands and Pedestals: studio pedestals (Vinten Vision Ped, Libec P1000, Miller, Cartoni Lifto).

name: Black-and-white reversal film
definition: black-and-white film processed by reversal to a positive slide or cine print.
notes: Foma Fomapan R100 listed as black and white reversal (transparency) film, R-100 reversal process.

name: Film dryer
definition: cabinet or heated unit that dries developed film hanging in strips.
notes: JOBO Mistral 3 heated drying cabinet dries hanging roll film, 8 rolls in 15-30 minutes.

name: Darkroom thermometer
definition: thermometer for chemistry temperature in film and print processing.
notes: Paterson 12-inch glass thermometer sold in Film & Darkroom; for all photographic processes.

name: Darkroom graduate
definition: measuring cylinder or jug for mixing photographic chemistry.
notes: Paterson plastic graduate 5 oz sold in Film & Darkroom, resistant to photographic chemicals.

name: Print tongs
definition: tongs for moving prints between trays without touching the chemistry.
notes: Paterson print tongs, three colour-coded pairs, one per tray: developer, stop, fixer.

name: Camera screen protector
definition: film or glass sheet cut to protect one camera's rear screen.
notes: SmallRig screen protector SR5803 cut for named cameras: Fujifilm X100V, X-T5, Ricoh GR IV.

name: Focusing screen
definition: interchangeable ground-glass screen fitted in a camera's viewfinder.
notes: B&H SLR Camera Focusing Screens category: Nikon Type E, Pentax ML-60, each for named bodies.

name: Camera dry cabinet
definition: humidity-controlled cabinet made to store cameras and lenses against fungus.
notes: Sirui HC series electronic humidity control cabinet stores photographic gear against moisture.

name: Electronic starting system
definition: electronic start unit that gives the start signal by sound and light in place of a blank pistol.
notes: Gill Halo electronic starter: ring with 12 LEDs and tone or bang via speaker, replaces blanks.

name: Elliptical cross trainer
definition: standing cardio machine with foot pedals on an elliptical path and moving arm handles.
notes: Retailer lists Horizon elliptical cross trainers Andes 7.1 and 7i; shop page thin.

name: Strong cider
definition: apple cider of higher strength than the traditional styles (BJCP C2).
notes: Ace High Imperial cider about 8% ABV sold as imperial-strength craft cider; Secret Seven 8.2%.
